evidence: Read engine/oddtask/fsdoc/fsdoc.go in the worktree. Reader.Read does Lstat, refuses a symlink or a non-regular file, opens the file, checks os.SameFile, and reads at most MaxDocumentBytes+1 bytes. A FIFO is refused at Lstat, before any open, so it cannot block.

Read engine/oddtask/reason.go. CauseLink is 'a symbolic link' and CauseNotRegular is 'not a regular file', matching the new test substrings. readRegular unwraps *ReadError, so the message becomes '<path> cannot be read (<cause>)'.
The callers in engine/workflow/app/open.go wrap errors as 'read goal: %v' and 'read feature document: %v'. The existing tests asserting those substrings still match.

The stage-failure message in open.go builds the recorded-stages list from PreWorkStages[:i], and 'none' when i is 0. The expected strings in open_test.go match: failing on classify gives 'after recording authorize, explore, resolve-uncertainty', and failing on authorize gives 'none'.

The race test makes LoadChain return nothing while the real store holds the first open's records. A differing document is refused at the shaper-record step with no later step run. An identical document is accepted as a no-op.
